name: hostfix-proxy
description: Make loopback-only backends work behind a TLS terminator. A tiny reverse proxy that rewrites Host/Origin so plugins that 403 any non-loopback Host stop breaking when served over Tailscale, Caddy, nginx or a tunnel.
author: Idlehanker

scripts.check: node --check src/proxy.js && node --check bin/cli.js && node --test test/*.test.js
